{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "hodlinator",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "reviewed and suggested renaming GetLogSource to Log() and adjusting log levels"
    },
    {
      "login": "maflcko",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "objected to using LogError for non-fatal errors"
    },
    {
      "login": "l0rinc",
      "stance": "question",
      "note": "asked why the PR is draft and whether a simpler scripted-diff rename would suffice"
    },
    {
      "login": "adyshimony",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "tested and ACKed; raised lifetime safety and log level concerns which were addressed"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:1655403164",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "rename GetLogSource() to Log() and keep m_log private in WalletStorage and Wallet",
      "quote": "Why not rename `GetLogSource()` -> `Log()` here and in `WalletStorage` and keep `m_log` private?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "implemented in commit and push",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:1656291638"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:1656291638",
      "status_by_quote": "Nice suggestion, implemented. This is much cleaner looking."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:1656474489",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "LogError is reserved for fatal errors requiring node shutdown, making its use for wallet errors inconsistent with guidelines",
      "quote": "Are you sure that `LogError` is the right level? It should only be used for fatal errors where the node needs to shut down, according to the docs.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "commit introducing LogError was dropped",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:1656555460",
        "rc:2879617275"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:2879617275",
      "status_by_quote": "Makes sense, and now dropped this commit since the code has changed since it was written."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:3791222986",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "asks whether PR is a draft due to dependency on #29256 and whether a simpler scripted-diff renaming WalletLogPrintf could be done instead",
      "quote": "Is it a draft because it's based on https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/29256 which should be reviewed first? That one has two nacks, can you make a version of this that simply renames the leftover `LogPrintf` reference",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained draft status and why scripted diff would lose wallet names",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:3791490692"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:3791490692",
      "status_by_quote": "I don't think we want to only replace WalletLogPrintf calls with LogInfo calls, because the point of WalletLogPrintf is to include wallet names in log messages"
    },
    {
      "id": "r:3871171023",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "rvalue source arguments can be bound by reference and used after their lifetime ends",
      "quote": "rvalue source arguments can be bound by reference and used after their lifetime ends. I tried to solve this in a few ways, but I think the most elegant simple one is to block rvalues at compile time",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "reviewer noted LIFETIMEBOUND is caught under Clang and gave ACK regardless of approach",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:2879657927",
        "r:3884040697"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:3997066867",
      "status_by_quote": "In any case, with either approach, ACK on 7fc95e7cbb3ee3cae14df02602ac51a3d910945c."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2868383376",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "logging normal operation under an error severity level",
      "quote": "Isn't that a happy flow? Maybe we can use LogInfo here?",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "commit containing the log level change was dropped",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:2879617275"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:2879617275",
      "status_by_quote": "Makes sense, and now dropped this commit since the code has changed since it was written."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:3997066867",
      "verdict": "ACK",
      "reason": "In any case, with either approach, ACK on 7fc95e7cbb3ee3cae14df02602ac51a3d910945c.",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "both",
      "areas": [
        "src/util/log.h"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "review of the rebased PR and underlying PRs",
      "id": "c:3997066867"
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Added suggestions and questions from hodlinator and l0rinc that were not tracked under schema 1. Updated clears_with to change for maflcko's and adyshimony's objections."
}
